stringUnit.value: Uses your phone’s date when selected. The range stays fixed until you change it. Filters apply locally to the supplied start day of loaded topics and activities; missing dates stay visible. Clubs and shops are not date-filtered.
按选择时手机上的日期填写；日期范围保持不变，直到再次修改。仅在本地按已加载主题和活动提供的开始日期筛选；缺少日期的结果仍会显示。俱乐部和商家不按日期筛选。
